Untracked kinds: 6,822 source/document/config/patch/evidence-text files, 65 other artifacts, 321 runtime/generated fixtures. JSON/TOML/patch/markdown/evidence logs are not blanket-discarded. There are 7,012 distinct untracked paths across the stashes.

Tracked/index review queue: 32 versions at 29 unique paths; 533 original base-to-version hunk intervals. Untracked review queue: 404 versions, including 22 direct src/tests/tools/docs paths. The other 382 are archive/overlay/handoff or other evidence candidates; they remain reviewable, not obsolete.

exactcovered means original mode and blob are identical in at least one audited immutable tree, or a recorded deletion has the same absent-path outcome. Same-path master equality proves that file snapshot only. A checkpoint or different-path copy proves preservation, **not integration or semantic acceptance**. 682 untracked occurrences have only a different-path exact witness. needsmanualhunkreview means no exact version witness among audited tips: code might already be reconciled differently. Blob mismatch never establishes obsolescence, loss, or a missing behavior. Hunk intervals below are candidates, not assertions that those edits are absent from master.

runtimeexcludedpreserved means excluded from source reconciliation only. The original third-parent tree and each original blob remain intact. No runtime data was removed. Runtime rules: explicit path segments __pycache__, .pytest_cache, .mypy_cache, .ruff_cache, .cache, .venv, venv, node_modules, scratch, state, runtime, cache, caches, test-temp, pytest-tmp; .pyc/.pyo/.sqlite/.sqlite3/.db and database sidecars; .sqlite.corrupt-* generated copies. Source overlay directories such as .tmp_dashboard_patch and verify-root-* are not excluded merely for being temporary.

## Reproducibility and bounds

- Read commands: git stash list --format=%gd%x09%H%x09%P%x09%s; git show -s --format=%P <index/untracked-parent>; git diff-tree -r --raw --no-abbrev --no-renames -z <base> <stash-or-index>; git ls-tree -r -z <immutable-target>; git cat-file --batch-check.
- Comparison target set: master and owner plus 126 named checkpoint refs, deduplicated to 100 immutable commit trees. Only current checkpoint tips are claimed, not every ancestor, unnamed object or unrelated branch. One concrete witness per exact row is sufficient; the dictionary below resolves it to commit SHA and captured refs.
- git cat-file verified all 3,767 distinct original/new/base blob OIDs used by this audit: no missing objects, all blob type. Parent topology: every index parent has the stash base as its sole parent; every third parent is a root commit. All 45 stashes have three parents; empty untracked trees are explicitly counted.
- Initial and pre-report stash identities matched; all 126 captured checkpoint refs still resolved to the same SHA. No model/test inference supports these findings: Git object identities and deterministic comparison are the evidence.
- Patch digests below are SHA-256 of UTF-8 stdout from git -c core.quotePath=false diff --no-ext-diff --no-textconv --no-renames --unified=0 <base-or-pinned-master> <source-commit> -- <path>. They identify reproducible evidence, not a trusted behavioral receipt.
- Retrieval: git show <stashSHA>:<tracked-path>, git show <indexParentSHA>:<index-path>, git show <untrackedParentSHA>:<untracked-path>, or git cat-file blob <blobSHA>. Use immutable SHAs instead of mutable stash selectors. Do not apply blindly.
